redirect.title: Short link click hua. Ab kya hoga?

steps.title: 1. Browser request bhejta hai
steps.body: User sho.rt/abc123 kholta hai. Request URL service tak aati hai — long URL abhi browser ko nahi pata.

steps.title: 2. Service Redis mein dekhti hai
steps.body: abc123 ki mapping cache mein hai? Hit ho toh DB ki zaroorat nahi. Is example mein cache miss hai.

steps.title: 3. Cache miss → database lookup
steps.body: Service DB se long URL aur expires_at laati hai. Missing ya expired mapping ho toh redirect nahi karegi.

steps.title: 4. Valid mapping ko cache karo
steps.body: DB se URL mil gaya. Redis mein mapping aur expiry store karo, taaki next click par DB read bach jaaye.

steps.title: 5. Browser original website kholta hai
steps.body: Service 302 response mein Location header bhejti hai. Browser us address par nayi request karta hai. Redis redirect nahi bhejta.

ranges.title: Har server ki apni ticket book

steps.title: 1. Server 1 ko range milti hai
steps.body: Allocator 1–100,000 durably reserve karta hai. Server 1 is range se locally IDs generate kar sakta hai.

steps.title: 2. Server 2 ko alag range milti hai
steps.body: Server 2 ko 100,001–200,000 milti hai. Dono independent kaam karte hain; ranges overlap nahi hoti.

steps.title: 3. Server 1 crash ho gaya
steps.body: ID 500 tak use hua. Restart par 501–100,000 dobara issue nahi karenge. Gaps okay hain; duplicates nahi.
steps.note: S1: down · unused IDs stay reserved

steps.title: 4. Server 2 nayi range reserve karta hai
steps.body: Apni pehli range khatam karke Server 2 allocator se 200,001–300,000 reserve karta hai. Woh automatically next IDs use nahi karta.

steps.title: 5. Server 1 fresh range leta hai
steps.body: Server 1 restart hua. Ab next globally unused range 300,001–400,000 milti hai. Request ko doosre server par move karne ki zaroorat nahi.

deletion.title: Purani mapping ko wapas aane se roko

steps.title: 1. A ko cache miss mila
steps.body: Request A DB se URL padhti hai. Is waqt mapping valid hai. Abhi A ne cache populate nahi kiya.

steps.title: 2. DB se link delete hua
steps.body: A ke read ke baad DB deletion commit hoti hai. A ke paas ab stale result hai — woh deletion ke baare mein abhi nahi jaanti.

steps.title: 3. CDC deletion event laata hai
steps.body: WAL se committed change read karke CDC worker ko batata hai. Sirf DEL karenge toh A baad mein old mapping wapas likh sakti hai.

steps.title: 4. Redis mein DELETED marker rakho
steps.body: Worker tombstone likhta hai: key ab absent nahi, DELETED hai. Yeh marker in-flight requests cover karne jitna long-lived hona chahiye.

steps.title: 5. A ka SET NX reject hota hai
steps.body: A cache fill karti hai, lekin key already present hai. Conditional write reject hoti hai. A ko marker respect karna hai aur stale URL se redirect nahi karna.
steps.note: SET NX blocked · no stale redirect

search.title: Samsung search ki request andar kaise chalegi?

steps.title: 1. User query bhejta hai
steps.body: React text aur allowed filters API ko bhejta hai. API validation aur permissions apply karegi.

steps.title: 2. Coordinator kaam baantta hai
steps.body: Relevant shard groups ki ek-ek copy select hoti hai. Primary aur replica dono ko same query chalana required nahi.
steps.note: Query phase → one copy per shard group

steps.title: 3. Local Lucene candidates nikaalta hai
steps.body: Har selected shard analyzed terms ki posting lists use karke candidates aur local scores nikaalta hai.

steps.title: 4. Coordinator winners choose karta hai
steps.body: Shard candidates merge hote hain. Selected hits ke fields fetch kiye jaate hain.

steps.title: 5. Results UI tak aate hain
steps.body: ES response API ko, API structured JSON React ko deti hai. Missing shards/timeout ko API handle karti hai.

indexing.title: Product bana. Search mein abhi kyun nahi aaya?

steps.title: 1. Dono records same transaction
steps.body: Product aur indexing intent saath commit hote hain. Dono ya koi nahi.

steps.title: 2. API creation acknowledge karti hai
steps.body: 201 ka matlab product committed hai. Search ready hona abhi promised nahi.

steps.title: 3. Publisher confirmed delivery karta hai
steps.body: Pending event broker ko bhejta hai, confirmation ke baad published mark. Crash gap duplicates la sakta hai.

steps.title: 4. Worker indexing karta hai
steps.body: Queue se event leta hai. Same product ID aur version guard ke saath ES write karta hai; temporary failure par bounded retry.

steps.title: 5. ACK, phir search visibility
steps.body: Successful handling par ACK. Search ke liye refresh visibility phir bhi required ho sakti hai; indexing aur refresh delays alag.

replicas.title: Node A gaya. Product copy pehle se kahan thi?

steps.title: 1. Healthy placement
steps.body: Three partition groups hain. Har group ki primary aur replica different nodes par already placed hain.

steps.title: 2. Node A unavailable
steps.body: P0 aur R2 unavailable. P0 ki existing replica R0 Node B par abhi bhi hai.
steps.note: Group 0: R0 survives; group 2: P2 survives

steps.title: 3. Eligible replica promote
steps.body: Healthy cluster coordination ke saath R0 new primary ban sakti hai. Crash ke baad dead node se copy nahi aa rahi.

steps.title: 4. Search relevant groups cover karegi
steps.body: Group 0/1/2 ki surviving copies targeted search execute karti hain. Replicas rebuild ke dauraan redundancy reduced ho sakti hai.
steps.note: All 3 groups available under these assumptions

steps.title: 1. Query analyze hui
steps.body: Lowercase token samsug hai. Engine ko correct brand pehle se guess nahi hua.

steps.title: 2. Edit constraint set hui
steps.body: Allowed edits aur exact prefix ke basis par nearby indexed terms explore ho sakti hain. Lucene automata dictionary traversal prune kar sakti hain.

steps.title: 3. samsung fits
steps.body: samsug mein n insert karne se samsung banta hai. Candidate term dictionary mein exist karta hai.

steps.title: 4. Ab documents nikaalo
steps.body: Matched term ki posting list se document candidates milte hain. Har product text par raw fuzzy scan nahi.

steps.title: 5. Matching ke baad ranking
steps.body: BM25 aur configured boosts decide karte hain. Galaxy aur Charger mein same term ho toh Galaxy automatically winner nahi.

request-basics.title: Browser ka request server tak kaise pahunchta hai?

steps.title: 1. Browser address leta hai
steps.body: User `example.com` kholta hai. Browser ko pehle iska network address chahiye.

steps.title: 2. DNS IP dhoondhta hai
steps.body: Browser DNS resolver se poochhta hai. Resolver hostname ke liye IP return karta hai.

steps.title: 3. HTTPS request connect hoti hai
steps.body: Browser resolved IP ke port 443 par HTTPS request bhejta hai. Port us machine par sahi network service tak traffic pahunchata hai.

steps.title: 4. App response wapas bhejti hai
steps.body: Server application request process karke HTTP response browser ko lautati hai. Ye ek request-response round trip hai.

cache-miss.title: Cache miss aaya—ab data kahan se milega?

steps.title: 1. Redis mein key check karo
steps.body: App photo:42 ki cached copy maangti hai. Key na mile toh request abhi bhi valid ho sakti hai.

steps.title: 2. Miss par database padho
steps.body: App source of truth se photo laati hai. Cache miss ko database ka not-found result mat samjho.

steps.title: 3. Copy rakh kar response do
steps.body: Photo milne par app Redis mein TTL ke saath copy rakhti hai, phir caller ko response deti hai.

cdn-edge.title: CDN edge par hit aur miss

steps.title: 1. Browser nearby edge tak aata hai
steps.body: CDN request ko user ke paas wale edge location par route karta hai.

steps.title: 2. Cache miss par origin se lo
steps.body: Edge ke paas copy nahi hai, toh woh origin se content fetch karta hai.

steps.title: 3. Agli request edge se
steps.body: Policy allow kare toh edge copy save karta hai. Agli request par origin ko dobara hit nahi karna padta.

steps.title: 1. API job queue ko bhejti hai
steps.body: Video upload accept hone ke baad thumbnail banane ka kaam queue mein rakha jaata hai.

steps.title: 2. User ko response milta hai
steps.body: Queue job ko sambhalti hai, isliye API worker ke poora hone ka wait kiye bina response bhej sakti hai.

steps.title: 3. Worker process karke ACK deta hai
steps.body: Worker task complete karta hai aur queue ko acknowledge karta hai. Crash ho toh redelivery ho sakti hai.

cap-partition.title: Do replicas, beech mein network partition

steps.title: 1. Normal case mein replicas baat karte hain
steps.body: A ka update network ke through B tak pahunch sakta hai; dono same latest value dekhte hain.

steps.title: 2. Network link toot gaya
steps.body: A aur B ek doosre ka update nahi dekh paa rahe. Partition tolerance ka scenario aa gaya.
steps.note: PARTITION · replicas out of sync ho sakti hain

steps.title: 3. Request ka behavior choose karo
steps.body: System wait/reject karke stale answer rok sakta hai, ya reachable replica se reply de sakta hai aur baad mein reconcile kar sakta hai.

reverse-proxy.title: Reverse proxy request ko backend tak pahunchata hai

steps.title: 1. Browser proxy se baat karta hai
steps.body: Public request reverse proxy par aati hai; client ko backend address ki zaroorat nahi hoti.

steps.title: 2. Proxy app ko forward karta hai
steps.body: Proxy configured backend ko request bhejta hai aur yahan filtering ya TLS handling bhi ho sakti hai.

steps.title: 3. Response proxy ke through lautata hai
steps.body: Application response reverse proxy se hote hue browser tak pahunchta hai.

steps.title: 1. Requirements clarify karo
steps.body: Features, users aur priorities poochho. Abhi solution draw karne ki jaldi nahi.

steps.title: 2. Scale ka rough estimate
steps.body: Requests aur data ka andaaza lagao; assumptions ke saath units bolo.

steps.title: 3. Minimum useful components
steps.body: Database, cache, queue ya CDN sirf clear reason par add karo.

steps.title: 4. Request/data flow trace
steps.body: Ek real user action ko entry se response tak follow karo.

steps.title: 5. Failure aur bottleneck
steps.body: Server, database aur worker fail ya slow hon toh behavior explain karo.

steps.title: 6. Trade-off state karo
steps.body: Choice kyun fit hai aur uski cost kya hai, interview mein saaf bolo.
